## Berlin Apartment Search Snapshot

You’re targeting a **1-bedroom apartment in Berlin** with a **move-in window of 2026-03-01 to 2026-04-15**, **€1,500/month max**, **≥45 m²**, **pet-friendly**, and **≤30 minutes by public transit to Alexanderplatz**.
Below is a practical pre-viewing checklist and a landlord message you can send right away.

## Booking-Ready Verification Checklist

| Priority | What to verify | Why it matters | How to confirm |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Total monthly cost** | Keeps the home within budget | Ask for **Warmmiete** and confirm what is included: heating, water, internet, electricity, parking |
| 2 | **Move-in date flexibility** | Your window is specific | Confirm earliest handover, lease start date, and whether the apartment can be held until your arrival |
| 3 | **Pet policy in writing** | “Pet-friendly” can be vague | Ask if **cats/dogs are allowed**, any breed/size limits, and whether extra deposit or approval is required |
| 4 | **Size and layout** | Ensures it truly fits your needs | Request the **official sqm**, room count, and a floor plan if available |
| 5 | **Transit time to Alexanderplatz** | Your commute limit is strict | Check the exact route in public transit apps at your likely commuting time, not just map distance |
| 6 | **Lease type and duration** | Avoids surprises | Confirm whether it is **unbefristet** or fixed-term, and whether renewal is possible |
| 7 | **Deposit and upfront costs** | Berlin move-ins can be expensive | Ask for deposit amount, agency fees, and first-month payment timing |
| 8 | **Registration eligibility** | Needed for Berlin admin tasks | Confirm you can receive a **Wohnungsgeberbestätigung** for Anmeldung |
| 9 | **Heating and energy efficiency** | Affects monthly cost | Ask about heating type, EPC/energy certificate, and average utility bills |
| 10 | **Condition and repairs** | Prevents hidden issues | Ask what is included, what is already damaged, and whether anything must be restored on move-out |

## Landlord Message You Can Send

Hello,

I’m interested in the apartment and would like to ask a few quick questions before arranging a viewing.

My requirements are:
- Move-in between **2026-03-01 and 2026-04-15**
- Budget up to **€1,500/month**
- **1 bedroom**, at least **45 m²**
- **Pet-friendly**
- Within **30 minutes by public transit of Alexanderplatz**

Could you please confirm:
- The **warm rent** and what is included
- Whether **pets are allowed** and if there are any restrictions
- The **exact move-in date** and lease terms
- The **official apartment size**
- Whether the apartment supports **Anmeldung**
- Any required documents for application

If the apartment is still available, I’d be happy to schedule a viewing.

Best regards,
[Your Name]

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Copy message] https://www.copy.ai/
Action: [Button: Check transit] https://www.bvg.de/en
Action: [Button: Search listings] https://www.immobilienscout24.de/
Action: [Button: Verify commute] https://www.google.com/maps

## Sources

- Berlin tenant registration basics: https://www.berlin.de/en/housing/registration/
- BVG public transit planner: https://www.bvg.de/en
- Berlin rental market listings: https://www.immobilienscout24.de/

Asset URL policy for this request:
- No local asset mapping is provided.
- Preserve media URLs from the response exactly as written.
- Do not invent local placeholder paths such as /image.jpg or /asset/foo.png.
